newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, brokers said on Thursday.
They said activity was limited as the Chinese have squared their positions for the Lunar New Year and the (local) ring sessions were featureless.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices turned lower in the afternoon as some speculative selling emerged. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 eased 0.25 cent to 122.00 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 fell 1.25 cents to 176.50 Singapore cents (US$1.26) a kg.
July/September TSR20 eased 0.25 cent to 170.50 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
